summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K and press release announcing a C$1B domestic public offering of NVCC subordinated debentures (medium term notes) through a dealer syndicate led by TD Securities Inc. The notes bear interest at 4.208% until June 2031, then Daily Compounded CORRA plus 1.27% until maturity in June 2036, redeemable at the Bank's option after June 2031 with regulatory approval. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including redemption of outstanding capital securities or repayment of liabilities. This is a standard capital market financing transaction, not a special situation.
